title: Answer-excluded upstream causal recomputation
question: Can upstream donor states change the answer through subsequent Transformer computation when the answer-position state itself is never patched?

models.selection_rule: first three behavior-qualified seeds per depth

controls.pre_source_prefix: positions 0-3; causal histories are identical and switching must remain absent
controls.answer_only: position 22 only; direct answer-state replay control

hard_stops: No analysis support may include answer position 22.
Behavior qualification cannot inspect hidden states or mechanism outcomes.
Exact oracle population scores cannot select a support or layer.
Confirmation cannot select a support, layer, threshold, or seed.
The final layer must show no answer-free switch while answer-only replay and with-answer suffix controls pass.
Primary answer-free recomputation and secondary sparse recomputation are reported separately.
No learned donor, component search, or pretrained model is run in this work package.
One formal run, zero adaptive rounds, no post-reveal seed or threshold changes.
